name: Zoran Kovačić
bio:
Zoran's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's repair shop in Zagreb. This early exposure ignited a passion for precision and performance, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduation, he honed his skills in the manufacturing sector before transitioning to motorsport, drawn by the challenge of crafting high-performance components under immense pressure.

He joined Eurofarma RC eight years ago, quickly becoming a valued member of the team. Zoran’s meticulous approach and ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues have earned him the respect of his colleagues. He is known for his innovative problem-solving and his relentless pursuit of perfection, traits that often lead to breakthroughs in component design and performance. His eye for detail and constant quest for improvement make him an invaluable asset.

What sets Zoran apart is his ability to blend traditional machining techniques with modern technologies. He's not afraid to experiment, pushing the boundaries of what's possible while maintaining a deep understanding of the fundamentals. He is also a mentor to younger machinists, sharing his knowledge and passion for the craft.
